title: Compute brief — 7 September 2026
description: Conversion splits: HyperVault locks Hyderabad land for up to 1 GW; OPSB dockets PORTS-Pike’s 765 kV; Stargate Korea stalls on power/site. Rental tape flat — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69.
og_kicker: Land and lines, not list prints
lede: The weekend’s conversion story is geographic, not silicon. TCS HyperVault locked 264 acres in Hyderabad for an up-to-1 GW AI campus (₹70,000 crore / ~$7.4B with partners; CM target June 2028), while Ohio’s OPSB put AEP’s Baku–Gavin 765 kV (~51 mi, ~$1.1B, developer-paid) on docket 26-0426-EL-BTX with an Oct 27 hearing — the grid permit that PORTS-Pike still needs. Same morning, Korea JoongAng reports Stargate Korea still has no site, power, or funding a year after the Samsung/SK MOU. The Silicon Tape is another clean confirm day: Lambda H100 $3.99 and B200 $6.69 unchanged.
